transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve been stuck in this low, heavy mood for years and I just don’t enjoy anything the way I used to. It feels like I'm just going through the motions every day, and I don't know how to get out of it.

During these years of feeling down, have there been periods of at least 2 months when your mood felt mostly normal? Also, have you ever had separate episodes lasting at least 2 weeks when the depression became much worse than your usual baseline?

No, I haven't had any breaks where I felt normal; it has been a steady, heavy feeling for a little over two years now without any relief. I also haven't had any separate periods where it got significantly worse—it has just been this same constant, draining baseline the entire time.

This pattern is most consistent with persistent mood disorder/dysthymia.
